name: Hidradenitis suppurativa — severe (Hurley II–III)
advice: Lose weight and stop smoking. Rifampicin turns urine orange and reduces pill efficacy — use condoms. Report diarrhoea (clindamycin). Before adalimumab: CBC, LFT, IGRA/Mantoux and chest X-ray, HBsAg, anti-HCV, HIV. Plan deroofing / wide excision of tunnels with surgery.

rx.instr: Many drug interactions; LFT at 4 weeks

rx.dose: 160 mg wk 0, 80 mg wk 2, then 40 mg weekly from wk 4
rx.instr: SC; If antibiotics fail / Hurley III; after TB and hepatitis screening
